title: H16 source-valid SiteRef refusal control
intent: Resolve the C269 H16.02 evidence gap using one source-valid declared/computed site reference and precise refusal propagation

requirements.acceptance: Freeze one declared/computed SiteRef fixture, exact import pin and independently authored unsupported-form expectation from adopted language rules and unchanged C260 before observation. No source evaluator or exporter supplies expected fields.

Execute source observation and applicable comparison for the frozen fixture. Require exact UNSUPPORTED_SOURCE_FORM, retained identities and reason, and no qualified partial set. Preserve every result. If contradicted, leave this acceptance unmet and queue a specific correction without implementation repair.

Preserve historical controls and implementation. Execute the scope-relevant regression inventory and documentation/workflow checks. Obtain independent exact-candidate review and resolve mandatory evidence findings.

Acquire expected-head lease, publish and review one branch/PR, conditionally integrate eligible evidence, verify actual main and retain history/observed branch disposition. A failed control is evidence, never successful qualification.

Confirm early recovery before substantial work; verify and save final ZIP and prompts, publish separate receipt, stop. Close parent/issue only when all gates pass; otherwise retain open scope and exact remaining action.
